Title: Engineering Analyst, Account and Device Intelligence
Description:
Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
2 years of experience in Data Science, Applied AI, or similar technical roles.


Preferred qualifications:


2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
Experience in deriving actionable insights, root causes, and intelligence from complex data sources across cybersecurity or anti-fraud, protecting users against cyber threats, and using AI to automate complex processes or operations
Ability to understand complex engineering systems and processes.
Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.
Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail and focus on getting things done.


About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

You will join a team of engineering analysts dedicated to protecting Google accounts and products from emerging threats. In this role, you will be at the cross-roads of cyber-security and AI, designing and implementing machine learning models and AI-powered agents to solve some of our most critical business challenges.

You will play a key part in a fast-paced environment where you will have the chance to apply your analytical and technical skills to complex problems at a global scale. This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to learn, innovate, and make a real impact.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities


Build a new AI-based capability leveraging our Transformers-based detection system to evolve and automate Incident Response, while generating threat intelligence that is relevant to protect Google accounts.
Transform, automate and scale up our team processes by developing AI Agents.Automate a large fraction of our operational workload, like alert generation and incident analysis, using techniques derived from ML, LLMs, operations research.
Apply our threat intelligence to be ready to respond to new adversarial campaigns.
Manage the response to incidents targeting Google Accounts, including the special response in case of severe incidents in collaboration with other partner teams.
Work with our Operations team to scale the operational work required to protect Google accounts, e.g, managing low severity escalations and alerts, and maintaining the ground truth quality. Provide the training and work to get tooling improvements when needed.



Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Title: Quant & Analytics Consultant - Financial Services Risk Consulting
Description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

Our Financial Services Risk Advisory team is responsible for both consulting and audit projects across various areas of Risk Management for Financial Services clients (e.g., banks, insurance companies, clearing houses, and private equities). We are looking for a Quantitative Risk Consultant for our Zürich office.

Join our dynamic department to tackle complex challenges and contribute to the future of the financial services industry!

At EY, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in a supportive and inclusive environment, leveraging global resources and technology to enhance your professional growth. We value your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Quantitative Risk Consultant at EY, you will be an integral part of our team, engaging in impactful projects from day one. Within our Quant & Analytics team, you will gain exposure to a wide range of quantitative aspects of risk management. You will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that align with your expertise, ensuring a rewarding and enriching experience. You will work with a diverse portfolio of high-profile domestic and international clients across all areas of financial risk.

Potential projects where you can contribute to:


Support our advisory as well as financial and regulatory audit engagements with leading financial institutions in risk management by:
Reviewing and developing quantitative models for measuring various risk types (market risk, credit risk, operational and fraud-related risks). You will perform statistical and quantitative analysis to validate models and present results internally, to clients, and to regulators via dedicated memos and presentations.
Valuating financial products and contracts: you will gain a comprehensive overview of current and latest trends in structured products and derivatives, the valuation techniques behind them, and their industry application for different client needs.
Analyzing the risk management function and risk appetite of our clients and assessing adherence to market, credit, liquidity, and operational risk regulatory requirements while establishing processes that enable an effective and controlled application of models along the whole lifecycle.
Designing and establishing AI governance and risk management frameworks in financial institutions by considering regulatory guidance, fostering innovation as well as identifying and measuring AI related (model) risks.
Supporting non-financial risk engagements in sustainability and climate risk and integrating those into existing risk frameworks.


You will be supported by a "counselor" who will guide you throughout your career development.

What We Look For


You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field (mathematics, physics, statistics, financial or computational engineering, econometrics) and might have 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in a consulting environment, a financial risk management team or a model development/validation team in the financial industry.
A strong interest in financial risk management and proven experience in applying new and classical quantitative techniques to solve risk management problems.
Profound analytical skills and the ability to combine method, rigor, and transversal skills.
Programming experience in languages such as Python, R, C#, or VBA is an advantage.
You are curious about innovation and new trends (such as AI, ML, LLM, and sustainability) in the banking and insurance sector.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and German (French is an advantage).
Skilled at explaining and simplifying complex topics to ensure understanding for different audiences.
You are open-minded, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to demonstrate initiative and a flexible working style in a multinational team.


What’s In It For You

Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology and surround you with high-performing teams. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need - all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone has equal access to opportunities. If you require any accommodation during the recruitment process, we are happy to support you.

Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Title: Member of Technical Staff, NeuroAI
Description:
Neurosoft Bioelectronics is developing next-generation AI for decoding neural time series (high-density subdural ECoG LFPs). We seek an intern machine learning scientist with interest in sequence modelling, state-space methods, self-supervised learning, and/or physics-informed machine learning to build foundation models that infer dexterous finger movements and continuous high DoF upper extremity kinematics, initially from only few minutes of brain data. The role spans research into modern system identification, representation learning, and real-time deployment of low-latency inference pipelines.




Tasks





Research design and benchmarking Kalman filters, RNNs, LSTMs, Structured State Space Models (S4/S5), Mamba, Neural ODEs, and related sequence architectures.


Research developing large-scale self-supervised pretraining pipelines and subject-specific fine-tuning workflows.


Research reproducing and exteding published SoTA neural decoding methods, beginning with LSTM baselines and modern SSM architectures.


Research decoding individual fingers, grasp synergies, continuous gestures, and full 6 DoF hand pose.


Research deploying streaming inference using ONNX, TensorRT, Triton, and GPU acceleration.


Research maintainance of reproducible benchmarking, MLOps, and production research infrastructure.









Requirements





Familiarity with Python, C/C++, Java, MATLAB, LaTeX, HTML, JavaScript, PyTorch, TensorFlow,


Familiarity with Signal Processing, Machine Learning,


Familiarity with Animal Care, Rodent Injections, Microscopy, Sterilization Techniques


Some capabilities in independent research, scientific writing, strategic planning, time management, presentation


Optional: Theoretical foundations of time-series modelling, system identification, dynamical systems, differential equations, control theory, and Bayesian estimation.


Optional: Recent implementation of Kalman filters, HMMs, linear/nonlinear SSMs, RNNs, LSTMs, S4/S5, Mamba, Neural ODEs, or Transformer-based sequence models.


Optional: Any experience with contrastive learning, VAEs, foundation-model pretraining, transfer learning, domain adaptation, and few-shot learning.


Optional: Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Docker, ONNX, TensorRT, Triton, GitHub, Linux, and MLflow.









Benefits





Growth: Opportunity to join an ambitious neurotechnology startup with exposure to multiple areas of company operations.


Culture: A collaborative and dynamic team environment with direct interaction with founders and leadership.


Flexibility: Hybrid work model with the possibility remotely and at the office in Geneva.


Compensation: Entry-level salary range of 45'000 - 55’000 CHF per year. First promotional review after 3 months.


Ownership: Equity participation through the employee option plan may be available.









We view neural decoding as a problem of system identification: learning latent state-space representations that increasingly approximate the underlying continuous dynamical system generating voluntary movement of a particular individual. Your role is about implementing, testing, and benchmarking the methods developed in collaboration with our academic partners.




Due to the novelty of this effort, this is a mandatory intake role across all seniority levels. At any point you take over an essential practice, tech stack, or reach an essential milestone, your compensation and authority will reflect that. Your role scope and growth are entirely metrics-driven and evaluated quarterly. This is a CSO-track role.

Title: Sr Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy company covering two business Sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. The Company is strategically positioned at the forefront of the energy transition as an integrated utility, while already established as a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at the European and global level. It has a consolidated turnover and EBITDA of €5,492 million and €1,014 million, respectively, and employs more than 6,583 direct and indirect employees in Greece and abroad.

At METLEN Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, positioned at the forefront of the energy transition while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at both the European and global levels. We are a global industrial and energy company operating across two highly interconnected and complementary sectors: Energy and Metals. With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.

We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.

We are currently looking for a highly motivated and analytical Quantitative Analyst to join our International Energy Trading division in Zug, Switzerland.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and refining quantitative models for asset valuation, optimization, price forecasting, and risk management, while providing actionable insights and high-quality tools to support trading decisions.

Your role will encompass:


Designing, implementing, calibrating, and validating quantitative models for asset valuation, optimization, price forecasting, and risk management.
Analyzing hedging strategies and portfolio effects and providing recommendations to traders.
Developing and validating option pricing models and applying financial mathematics to support trading and risk decisions.
Collaborating closely with traders, quantitative analysts, and other business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
Developing and maintaining user-focused quantitative tools that support day-to-day portfolio management and optimization.


What you bring to the role:


M.S. or PhD in Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Quantitative Finance, or a related field.
Broad knowledge of commodity markets, ideally combined with relevant industry experience.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Rust, Python, C#, C++, or VBA, with experience in R, MATLAB, or relevant front-end frameworks considered an advantage.
Experience working with external models and quantitative tools, including ETRM, valuation, and optimization platforms.
In-depth knowledge of financial mathematics, including derivatives pricing, option theory, and risk analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative concepts into practical solutions for trading and portfolio management.


Your Benefits:


Competitive remuneration package including performance-based bonus structure linked directly to PnL
Opportunities for responsibility, ownership, and career growth as the business expands
Group Health Insurance Plan

Title: R&D Engineer AI, Robotics & Industrial Inspection (F/M/D) 100%
Description:
Facing the challenges of our time

Help us grow and be more impactful!

The Industrial Inspection group, based in Alpnach, develops intelligent algorithms and systems for industrial inspection, automation and robotics. Our activities cover the full innovation chain, ranging from applied research and proof-of-concept development to the implementation and deployment of industrial solutions for national and international customers.

Your mission

As an R&D Engineer, your mission is to develop and implement state-of-the-art algorithms and AI-based software systems for industrial applications. You will contribute to machine learning, deep learning, computer vision and agentic AI solutions for inspection, robotics and automation. Working in multidisciplinary teams, you will transform innovative concepts into robust prototypes and industrial solutions that create measurable value for our partners.

Your Responsibilities


Design, develop and validate machine learning, deep learning and data-driven algorithms for industrial inspection, robotics and automation applications.
Design, train and optimize modern neural network architectures for industrial use cases.
Develop computer vision systems using 2D and 3D sensor data for tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, anomaly detection, tracking and pose estimation.
Design, implement and evaluate agentic AI systems using large language models, retrieval mechanisms, tools and automated workflows for industrial applications.
Develop robust software applications, prototypes and demonstrators using Python and, where appropriate, C#.
Build data acquisition, preparation, processing and evaluation pipelines for AI-based systems.
Contribute to the integration of AI solutions into robotic platforms, automation systems and industrial software environments.
Participate in project phases from concept development and feasibility studies through implementation, testing, validation and deployment.
Design and execute experiments, evaluate performance and document results in a structured and reproducible manner.
Contribute technical expertise to customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations and project proposals.
Continuously monitor relevant state-of-the-art developments and transfer promising methods into applied industrial projects.


Your profile


Master's degree, in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
Up to four years of relevant professional experience in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, robotics, automation or software engineering.
Strong academic foundation in algorithm development, machine learning and data-driven systems.


Know-how


Strong programming skills in Python.
Good understanding of professional software development practices and Git-based development workflows.
Practical experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, neural network design and data-driven algorithm development.
Fluent in modern AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), agentic AI systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-integrated workflows and AI-assisted software development.
Ability to evaluate, design and implement AI-driven solutions using classical algorithms, machine learning methods and modern foundation models.
Knowledge of computer vision fundamentals and practical image processing using OpenCV.
Experience developing, training, testing and evaluating data-driven algorithms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to independently implement, validate and document software solutions from concept to prototype.


Interpersonal skills


Structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
Curious, self-driven and eager to learn emerging technologies.
Pragmatic, hands-on mindset and willingness to work across algorithms, software and physical systems.
Strong collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams.
Ability to communicate technical topics clearly to colleagues, customers and project partners.
Fluent English is required. German a strong asset.


CSEM mission and values

We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.

At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.

Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.

Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.

We are


A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world


Working@CSEM means


Being part of a passionate community.
Incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development.
Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.

Title: Senior BI & Analytics Engineer – Qlik, Data Science & AI (m/w/d)
Description:
Wie sieht die Zukunft der Luftfahrt aus? Unser Rocken Partner gestaltet sie aktiv mit. Als etablierter Technologiepartner entwickelt und wartet er hochkomplexe Systeme und Komponenten, die weltweit im Einsatz sind. Präzision, Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation stehen im Zentrum des Handelns. Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – von der Entwicklung über die Fertigung bis hin zu umfassenden Wartungs- und Modernisierungslösungen. Dabei werden höchste Qualitätsstandards mit technologischem Fortschritt verbunden. Jedes Projekt trägt dazu bei, Sicherheit und Leistungsfähigkeit auf ein neues Level zu heben. Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein prägen die Zusammenarbeit. Fachliche Exzellenz trifft auf echten Teamgeist. Bereit, an Lösungen zu arbeiten, die wirklich zählen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich mit unserem Rocken Partner zusammenzubringen.

Rolle

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von BI-Lösungen mit Qlik Sense. Du analysierst komplexe Datenquellen, modellierst Daten und bereitest sie so auf, dass fundierte Entscheidungen auf einer klaren, visuellen Basis getroffen werden können. Ausserdem definierst du Standards und Best Practices im BI-Umfeld und stellst sicher, dass Datenqualität und -konsistenz jederzeit gewährleistet sind. Als Senior BI Specialist berätst du fachliche Stakeholder, übersetzt ihre Anforderungen in effiziente Dashboards und Reports und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der BI-Landschaft voran.

Verantwortung


Du entwickelst aussagekräftige Dashboards, Auswertungen und Reports mit Qlik Sense und stellst deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung sicher.
Du gestaltest neue Analytics-Services und bringst datenbasierte Planung, Predictive Analytics und KI in konkrete Business-Anwendungen.
Du betreibst und optimierst die bestehende Analytics-Plattform und entwickelst den On-Premises-Toolstack gezielt weiter.
Du etablierst Best Practices für BI, Data Science und künstliche Intelligenz und unterstützt das Team beim Aufbau moderner Analysekompetenzen.
Du berätst Fachbereiche bei der Anforderungsdefinition, übersetzt komplexe Fragestellungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und förderst die Data Literacy im Unternehmen.


Qualifikationen


Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.
Du bringst mehrjährige, vertiefte Praxis in Qlik Sense mit, idealerweise in einer lokal betriebenen Analytics-Umgebung.
Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Machine Learning und Data Science sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.
Du verstehst ETL, Datenmodellierung und relationale Datenbanken und kennst idealerweise MSSQL, Talend sowie SAP S/4HANA.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, qualitätsbewusst und eigeninitiativ, kannst analytische Inhalte verständlich vermitteln und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten/Projekte

Title: Senior Research Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
Who We Are:

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

Overview:

We are looking for a world-class Senior Research Scientist to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

Your Responsibilities:

Research & Development:


Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation.


Scaling Laws & Data:


Develop strategies for multi-modal data collection, synthetic data generation, and efficient fine-tuning of large-scale models.


Algorithm Optimization:


Optimize model inference for real-time robotic applications without compromising reasoning capabilities.


Publication & Visibility:


Contribute to the global research community by publishing high-impact papers at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, CoRL, etc.).


Collaboration:


Work closely with the Core Robotics and Hardware teams to integrate AI models into our physical platforms.


Qualifications:

Academic Excellence:


PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field, with a focus on Deep Learning and Computer Vision.


Proven Research Track Record:


Significant publications and citations at major conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, IROS, or CoRL.


Professional Background:


Experience working in leading AI research environments


Technical Mastery:


Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, experience with Transformers, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).


Domain Knowledge:


Strong understanding of Vision-Language models and their application to Action/Control loops in robotics.


Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:


This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.


What we offer:


Wellpass (gym membership).
Free meals at the workplace.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.
Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.
Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.
A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.
Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area

Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

Title: AIML - Machine Learning Researcher, Multimodal Foundation Models
Description:
Summary
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. We are a group of engineers and researchers building multimodal foundation models at Apple, with a particular focus on image understanding and generation. We build infrastructure, datasets, and models with fundamental general capabilities and work with a cross-functional partners to apply these models to ship features to millions of users. We are looking for researchers who are passionate about developing algorithms, techniques, and systems that push the frontier of deep learning and delight millions of users with Apple products powered by foundation models.

Description
We believe that the most interesting problems in deep learning research arise when we try to apply learning to real-world use cases, and this is also where the most important breakthroughs come from. You will work with a close-knit and fast-growing team of world-class engineers and scientists to tackle some of the most challenging problems in foundation models and deep learning, including natural language processing, multi-modal understanding, and combining learning with knowledge. You will have opportunities to identify and develop novel applications of deep learning in Apple products. You will see your ideas not only published in papers, and also improve the experience of millions of users.

Minimum Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in deep learning with a publication record in relevant conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, KDD, ACL)
Deep understanding of multi-task, multi-modal machine learning domain
Proficient programming skills in Python and one of the deep learning toolkits such as JAX, PyTorch, or Tensorflow
PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Science, or related technical field


Preferred Qualifications

A track record in applying deep learning techniques to shipping products
Multi-modal perception for existing products and future hardware platforms
On-device intelligence and learning with strong privacy protections
Ability to quickly prototype ideas / solutions, perform critical analysis, and use creative approaches for solving complex problems.
Ability to collaborate closely with globally distributed teams.

Title: Senior Consultant - Artificial Intelligence & Data - (AI & Insights focus)
Description:
Job Description

Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva

Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices

Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. 

We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward.

How You Can Make An Impact


Develop data strategies that allow our clients to reach their business objectives across regulatory, cost, and revenue pillars.
Design complex data & analytics transformations by providing architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership and guide clients in executing these transformations, which have significant organizational implications.
Drive Data & AI use cases from business value concept to production
Develop and maintain trusted client relationships through project work or business development and expand your network both internally and externally.
Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
Grow expertise in different industry and subject matter areas and share your knowledge with the rest of Deloitte talent.



What We Are Looking For:

Drive and Motivation:


Passionate individuals looking to make a career in Consulting.
Ability to manage multiple activities in a high-paced environment and deliver independently.



Consulting and Communication Skills:


Strong Microsoft Power Point skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
Business-IT Translator: Proficient in leading requirement analysis and acting as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions
Team Collaboration and Leadership: Proven ability to guide nearshore and offshore technical implementation teams, ensuring effective collaboration and project success.
Technical Integration: Skilful in integrating system components, providing clear business explanations, and leading technical workshops.



Technical Expertise:


Strong Engineering and/or Mathematics background.
Solid experience with Python. Experience with R is a plus.
Experience delivering Generative AI, AI, Machine Learning and/or Analytics solutions on one or more of the cloud services providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and adjacent services required to bring use cases to production on one or more of the cloud service providers above is highly preferred.
Experience with data science workbench tools such as Snowflake, Databricks and Dataiku is a plus.
Experience with Data Visualization tools such as PowerBI and Tableau is a plus.



Language Proficiency:


Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders.



Industry Experience:


At least 3 years of practical experience in consulting, tech companies, or industry-specific roles, particularly in data-driven fields.
Previous experience in the Banking, Insurance, Life Science or Healthcare sector is advantageous.



Your team

Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data - how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities.

Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want.

We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries.

Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.

In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers .

Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Design, prototype, deploy, and continuously improve Agentic AI solutions and reusable orchestration frameworks (from concept to production)
Align automation pipelines with business priorities while enforcing responsible AI principles and compliance standards (including GxP)
Partner with Data Scientists, process designers, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated and scalable solutions
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and empower citizen developers by actively contributing to our internal AI Community of Practice


Your profile


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML solution development, at least 1–2 years focused on Agentic AI, large language models (LLMs), or intelligent automation
Strong Python proficiency. Deep expertise in Agentic AI frameworks, prompt engineering, AI orchestration, and scalable, production-grade architectures.
Experience in regulated industries (pharma, manufacturing) is a strong advantage
Preferred certifications: AI/ML Engineering, Agentic AI platforms, Cloud AI services, Agile delivery
Strategic & Action-Oriented: Translates business challenges into practical AI solutions with a delivery-focused mindset
Collaborative Communicator: Easily explains complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and drives cross-functional teamwork
Curious: Intellectually driven with a continuous learning mindset
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Title: AI ENGINEER | AI | COMPUTER VISION
Description:
Techyon is the first Head Hunter specialising exclusively in the search and selection of senior professionals and managers in the Information Technology field. Our Recruitment Engineers select the best IT profiles for prestigious IT consulting firms, banks, service companies, manufacturing groups, start-ups of excellence and digital DNA companies.

About the Company: Our client is a cutting-edge Swiss technology company at the forefront of developing Artificial Intelligence-based Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems. Operating in the global electronics manufacturing market (EMS/OEM), the company provides solutions for critical sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace, and Medical devices. Its mission is to redefine quality control standards by integrating patented 3D optical heads and proprietary neural networks, delivering unprecedented accuracy in defect detection on printed circuit boards (PCBs). For this company our Recruitment Engineers are looking for an AI Engineer.

The role offers the opportunity to work on challenging computer vision problems in an industrial environment, driving the development of innovative solutions for automated optical inspection and advanced image analysis, while also providing technical guidance and mentorship to other members of the team.

Job Requirements

Must have:


Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another relevant scientific discipline
Professional experience in computer vision and/or applied AI, ideally within an industrial or product-development setting
Expert-level programming skills in Python
Extensive, proven experience in Computer Vision and Image Processing, particularly using OpenCV
Hands-on experience with Deep Learning applied to computer vision and image analysis, including designing and training models for real-world applications
Deep, hands-on expertise with at least one major deep learning framework, preferably PyTorch, including model optimization and deployment.
Deep, practical understanding of common computer vision tasks, such as image classification, object detection, segmentation, feature extraction, and anomaly detection, and the ability to choose and adapt the right approach for a given problem
Experience with object-oriented programming, preferably with Java or a similar language
Proven ability to autonomously design and implement reliable software components and integrate computer vision algorithms into production systems
Extensive experience working with real-world image datasets, including data preparation, augmentation and labeling.


Nice to have:


Experience with 3D computer vision, 3D reconstruction, depth processing, or 3D modeling is a plus
Knowledge of C++ is a plus


Other Info

Location: Mendrisio (Switzerland). On-site work mode.

Compensation: 72.000 CHF

12 months temporary contract




In this highly strategic and technically demanding role, you will lead the development, implementation, and optimization of Generative AI solutions across multiple business functions. You will work closely with senior leadership, cross‑functional experts, and technical teams to design AI architectures, build advanced LLM‑based products, and drive enterprise‑level innovation. Develop and steer the Generative AI roadmap in alignment with organizational priorities and business needs.

Ph.D. in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

At least 2 years of experience designing modular multi‑agent systems, secure agent‑to‑agent frameworks and enterprise‑grade LLM architectures.
Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills with fluency in English.

Title: 2027 Graduate Talent Program – AI & Data Engineer – Zurich

Interested in working in finance, and have a passion for technology and AI, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Group Technology Office Graduate Talent Program.

You’ll Get To


design and build an AI-ready Data Mesh capability for Global Investment Management Discretionary Mandates
develop data products that are trusted, well-documented and consumable by reporting, analytics, machine learning and generative AI solutions
work with engineers, data owners and business stakeholders to define data domains, ownership models, metadata standards, quality controls and lineage requirements
contribute innovative ideas and fresh perspectives to innovate


Your team

You’ll be working in the Group Technology Office located in Zurich as part of a global team spread across Switzerland, Poland and India. We’re responsible for sourcing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting our world-class technology solutions. We’re a global organization with multiple streams that align with each of the key functional areas within UBS to ensure that our solutions meet business needs.

Based on your interests and experience, you could be placed as a Data Engineer Graduate.

Your expertise

We’re Looking For a Candidate Who


is a recent graduate (graduated in the last 24 months)
has fully completed their degree and met all graduation requirements by the program start date
has no more than two years of full-time work experience


has completed their bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in a MINT topic.


has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
has knowledge of software engineering, data engineering, cloud technologies and modern data architectures
demonstrates curiosity and practical experience with AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies and can articulate how responsible AI can create measurable business value


Start date: 1 February 2027

Your program

Our Graduate Talent Program is 18 months long, and designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career. To start, the program introduces you to our firm, provides professional and technical training and teaches you core skills and knowledge of the Group Technology Office. And it continues from there: by learning from your colleagues, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and build your network. You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your job by participating in one, or several, rotations. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

About Us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. Desenvolver e manter modelos analíticos e preditivos em Python, desde a exploração dos dados até o deploy em produção.
Trabalhar próximo às áreas de negócio para entender problemas, formular hipóteses e comunicar descobertas de forma clara e objetiva.
Garantir a qualidade, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade das soluções entregues.
Analisar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados para identificar padrões e tendências.
Propor e implementar soluções inovadoras para desafios de negócio utilizando técnicas de ciência de dados.

Sólida base em estatística — testes de hipótese, distribuições, regressão, inferência.

Boa comunicação para traduzir resultados técnicos para públicos não técnicos.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack Studio
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will partner with some of the world’s leading organizations to tackle their most critical challenges using data.

From data owners and end users to C-level executives, you will work closely with clients to understand their needs and design impactful analytics solutions that drive performance.

You will be a key contributor in cross-functional problem-solving sessions, translating complex business questions into analytical problems and building models that address them—ensuring those models are evaluated with relevant, actionable metrics.

You will help shape the development of our internal Data Science Toolbox, writing highly optimized code and supporting the delivery of innovative, scalable solutions.

You will also:


Present your work to colleagues and clients, communicating insights in a clear and compelling way
Write and present papers at internal and external conferences (such as NeurIPS and ICML), if you choose to
Join global retrospectives and R&D initiatives, learning and sharing alongside experts across QuantumBlack
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams that bring together data science, engineering, design, and business expertise


Our projects range from accelerating clinical research to improving urban air quality or enhancing elite sport performance - always focused on creating real-world impact.

You will be based in Sao Paulo and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, machine learning specialists, designers, and product managers from around the world.

Together, you will work across sectors - such as healthcare, automotive, energy, finance, and more - to apply mathematical, statistical, and machine learning approaches to real-world data.

At QuantumBlack Studio, your growth is continuous and personalized.

You will benefit from:


Diverse projects and clients, giving you international exposure and unique challenges
Cutting-edge tools and technologies, enabling you to sharpen your skills in modern data science workflows
Tailored learning and mentorship, including training programs, technical deep dives, and global knowledge-sharing
Career path flexibility, with opportunities to explore new domains or geographies as you grow


A strong sense of community, connecting with colleagues through meetups, workshops, and events across the QuantumBlack Studio and McKinsey networks. You’ll help shape how we define excellence in data science.Please submit your CV in English.

Your Qualifications and Skills


University degree with a strong academic record; master’s in computer science, applied statistics, mathematics, artificial intelligence, or related field preferred
2+ years of experience applying machine learning and data mining techniques to large, real-world datasets
Strong background in computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, physics, or similar
Ability to lead and drive model development independently, balancing quality and deadlines
Proven track record in prototyping and applying advanced analytical and statistical methods
Proficiency in Python and at least one additional language (e.g., R, Scala, SQL)
Experience working with relational databases (SQL) and large datasets
Experience in the real-world application of machine learning methods and algorithms
Business level language fluency, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese

Title: Senior Data Scientist - QuantumBlack Studio
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You’ll lead the development of cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions that tackle some of the most complex business challenges across industries—delivering measurable impact at scale.

You will leverage the latest advances in deep learning, reinforcement learning, and AI to uncover insights and improve business performance. You will mentor other data scientists, shape QuantumBlack Studio’s R&D roadmap, and identify high-potential machine learning initiatives for industry application. Working closely with data engineers, machine learning engineers, and designers, you will build end-to-end analytics solutions that create real-world impact.

Your work will transform industries. By leveraging advanced AI techniques and collaborating with industry leaders, you will help clients gain a competitive edge, solve critical challenges, and achieve lasting improvements in their operations.

You will be based in São Paulo and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world. Together, you’ll work on interdisciplinary projects to solve complex business challenges across a range of industries. Collaborating with QuantumBlack Studio leadership, client executives, and technical experts, you will lead the development and application of cutting-edge machine learning and AI solutions to drive measurable business impact.

You’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll work on high-impact projects, connect technology with business value, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic perspective of AI’s transformative potential while advancing as a technologist and leader.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
5+ years of deep technical experience in distributed computing, machine learning, and statistics related work
Programming experience in languages such as: Python, R, Scala, SQL
Proven application of advanced analytical, data science and statistical methods in the commercial world
Knowledge of distributed computing or NoSQL technologies is a bonus
Client-facing skills e.g. working in close-knit teams on topics such as data warehousing, machine learning
While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
Demonstrated leadership (thought leadership or people leadership e.g. managed project teams or direct reports)
Willingness to travel
Good presentation and communication skills, with a knack for explaining complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and Portuguese, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

Title: Cientista de Dados | BTG Empresas
HTML:
O BTG Pactual está contratando um Cientista de Dados Sênior para ser parte da construção da nova geração de modelos de crédito para PMEs.

Este profissional terá mandato para sugerir e implantar novos modelos para a esteira de aprovação, manutenção e recuperação de crédito. Terá autonomia para aplicar técnicas clássicas e sofisticadas, sempre se baseando em argumentos técnicos e quantitativos.

Sobre a Área

O BTG Empresas é uma frente em forte crescimento dentro do BTG, com expansão contínua de portfólio, lançamento de novos produtos e estruturas — incluindo novas modalidades de garantias e instrumentos financeiros.

Operamos como um banco digital para PMEs, com uma esteira de crédito moderna, escalável e orientada a dados.

Dentro dessa estrutura, a área de crédito desempenha papel estratégico na implementação de políticas e modelos de concessão, manutenção, precificação e monitoramento de clientes.

Nosso principal objetivo é construir uma esteira que aprova o máximo de crédito com a menor inadimplência e máxima rentabilidade.

No Seu Dia a Dia

Trabalhar no time de crédito do BTG Empresas, responsável por criar políticas e modelos para PMEs em produtos de rotativos, parcelados, descontos e trade finance.

Criar, avaliar e acompanhar os modelos de crédito do BTG Empresas.

Pensar em novas hipóteses, fontes de dados e abordagens para novos modelos.

Acompanhar e validar a implantação dos modelos junto aos times de tecnologia.

Trabalhar com proximidade dos times de Data Analytics e Motor de Crédito.

Trabalhar com proximidade do time de políticas e áreas de produto.

Requisitos Técnicos

Experiência com técnicas de modelagem estatística e machine learning por 5 anos ou mais (obrigatório) — Mestrado na área conta como experiência.

Experiência em programação com Python e SQL. (obrigatório)

Amplo domínio em técnicas de classificação, regressão, clusterização e otimização. (obrigatório)

Domínio de algoritmos clássicos e modernos de aprendizado, como árvores de decisão, regressão linear/logística, ensemble e boosting models. (obrigatório)

Base em inferência estatística. (desejável)

Experiência em modelos de crédito, risco ou eventos raros. (desejável)

Familiaridade com avaliação e acompanhamento de modelos, além de técnicas de visualização de dados. (desejável)

Benefícios

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição;
  • Plano Médico;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • WellHub;
  • TotalPass;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal (EAP);
  • Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida;
  • Desconto em Farmácia;
  • Programa de Nutrição;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã

Title: Data Scientist II, Amazon 1P Credito, Payments
Description:
Description

Do you feel the challenge and the adrenaline kick when a huge data-set stares you in the face and you know that somewhere inside are hidden very important business insights that can fundamentally alter the way top business leaders think and act? Do you enjoy presenting strong data backed insights to business leaders; insights that can topple their long held beliefs and compel them to change their direction completely? If yes, then you are the one we are looking for.

We are looking to invite passionate leaders, with expertise in generate power business insights from very large datasets, on a journey where the primary aim would be to enable needle moving business impacts through statistical analysis. We are looking for leaders who can envision the design and development of analytical infrastructure which can support strategic and tactical decision-making. Those who join this high visibility team would have to navigate through significant ambiguity in defining business problems and converting them to analytical problems.

This role requires additional exposure and experience to Machine Learning.

Key job responsibilities


Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes
Design, development, evaluate and deploy innovative and highly scalable models for predictive learning
Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches
Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations and new feature creations
Work closely with business owners and operations staff to optimize various business operations
Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model implementation
Mentor other scientists and engineers in the use of ML techniques
Innovate with the latest GenAI technology to build highly automated solutions for efficient customer promotions
Design, develop and deploy end-to-end machine learning solutions in the Amazon production environment to delight Amazon customers
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive ML/statistical models that can scale to millions of customers to multiple countries


About The Team

Brazil Payments is part of the International Emerging Stores Payments team and focuses on supporting the launch of new payment and financial products to our customers in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications


Experience working as a Data Scientist
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)
Experience with machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance
Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AI/ML technologies
PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields
Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive)
Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

HTML:
Nossa área de Ciência de Dados

Nossa área de Ciência de Dados transforma dados em decisões de negócio. Trabalhamos de forma próxima às áreas parceiras para desenvolver soluções analíticas, modelos e produtos de dados que geram impacto real no dia a dia da empresa e dos clientes.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Brazil)
Description:
About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us


Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.


About The Role

CharterUP is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to help build the analytical and modeling capabilities behind our marketplace and pricing systems. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Availability teams to understand marketplace dynamics, develop rigorous analyses, and turn data into recommendations that improve pricing and business performance.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll have the opportunity to work across exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, experimentation, forecasting, and machine learning. You’ll help establish reliable data foundations and shared metrics while solving complex problems in a dynamic marketplace environment.

Title: Senior Data Scientist

Reports to: Staff Data Scientist

Location: Remote, Brazil

What You’ll Do


Hands-On Data Science: Conduct exploratory analysis, driver analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning to solve complex marketplace and pricing problems.
Pricing & Marketplace Analytics: Analyze pricing behavior, supply and demand dynamics, elasticity, conversion, and other marketplace signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
Experimentation & Modeling: Support the design and analysis of experiments and develop predictive models, forecasts, and other analytical solutions that inform product and business decisions.
Data Quality & Foundations: Partner with Data Engineering and other technical teams to improve data pipelines, datasets, definitions, and data quality for analytics and machine learning.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Pricing, Availability, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into clear analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Data Storytelling: Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, helping stakeholders understand the implications and tradeoffs behind your recommendations.
Production ML: Contribute to the development, deployment, monitoring, and improvement of machine learning models as the team's data science capabilities mature.
Best Practices: Help establish strong practices around statistical rigor, experimentation, reproducible analysis, and data science workflows.


Key Initial Objectives


Partner with the Staff Data Scientist on a rigorous first deep dive into pricing and marketplace economics.
Deliver structured, decision-ready analysis that directly informs the pricing roadmap.
Help identify and document data quality gaps encountered during analysis, in partnership with Engineering.
Contribute to shared metric definitions used consistently across Product, Finance, and Revenue.
Begin laying the groundwork for scalable forecasting and machine learning capabilities.


What You’ll Bring


Data Science Experience: 4–7+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field, with experience independently owning complex analytical projects.
Machine Learning & Statistical Expertise: Strong experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, forecasting, or optimization to solve business problems. Experience with pricing, marketplaces, supply and demand, or other dynamic systems is highly valued.
Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with experience working with large datasets and building reliable analytical datasets.
Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to break down ambiguous business problems, identify the right analytical approach, and turn complex data into practical recommendations.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect analytical findings to business outcomes and communicate the implications of your work to Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Production ML: Experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production is a plus.
AI/ML: Familiarity with modern AI/ML techniques, LLMs, or NLP is a plus.
Marketplace Experience: Experience in pricing, marketplaces, transportation, travel, e-commerce, logistics, or another environment with complex supply and demand dynamics is a plus.


Recruiting Process


Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews (x3)
Step 4 - Video call: Case Study & Panel Presentation
Step 5 - Offer & reference check
Welcome aboard!


Compensation

$6,000–$7,000 USD per month

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, Miami, and Denver as we grow our global team.


Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.


CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

Title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados Sênior
Description:
Resumo: Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar em um cliente Ideen de atuação global, em um time que transforma dados em decisão de negócio dentro de uma operação de larga escala. A posição é para quem gosta de percorrer o ciclo completo — do entendimento do problema de negócio à modelagem, ao deploy e ao monitoramento em produção — e de trabalhar lado a lado com engenharia, produto e áreas de negócio. É um ambiente com alta exposição internacional: interação diária com times e lideranças globais, contato direto com stakeholders sêniores e visibilidade real do impacto do seu trabalho. Um contexto que abre caminho para crescimento acelerado e para construir repertório em problemas de dados complexos e de grande volume.

Responsabilidades:


Desenvolver, treinar, validar e colocar em produção modelos de machine learning e modelos estatísticos para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.
Analisar bases de dados extensas e complexas para identificar padrões, correlações, tendências e insights acionáveis.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de data science e machine learning.
Executar pré-processamento de dados, feature engineering, análise exploratória (EDA) e avaliação de modelos.
Construir modelos preditivos, de classificação, regressão, clusterização e outras abordagens conforme o caso de uso.
Otimizar e ajustar modelos para ganhos de acurácia, escalabilidade e performance.
Desenhar e implementar soluções de ponta a ponta, da preparação dos dados ao deploy do modelo.
Monitorar a performance dos modelos em produção e evoluí-los continuamente conforme as necessidades do negócio.
Comunicar achados analíticos e resultados de modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, engenheiros de software, product managers e stakeholders de negócio, incluindo times internacionais.
Seguir boas práticas de qualidade de código, documentação, testes, versionamento e governança de modelos.


Requisitos:


Inglês fluente (mandatório). A interação com times e lideranças internacionais é diária, em reuniões, documentação e comunicação escrita.
Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido, 2 a 3x por semana, na região da Paulista.
6+ anos de experiência total em software, analytics, dados ou funções técnicas correlatas.
3+ anos de experiência prática atuando especificamente como Cientista de Dados.
Sólida experiência de programação em Python.
Conhecimento consistente de algoritmos e conceitos de Machine Learning.
Experiência com bibliotecas e frameworks como scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow ou PyTorch.
Bom domínio de estatística, probabilidade, modelagem de dados e desenho experimental.
Experiência prática com pré-processamento, feature engineering, treinamento, validação e avaliação de modelos.
SQL avançado e vivência com bases relacionais e/ou plataformas de dados de larga escala.
Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib ou similares).
Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
Formação superior (graduação ou mestrado) em Ciência da Computação, Data Science, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou área correlata.


Diferencial:


Conhecimento de MLOps, deploy de modelos, CI/CD e fluxos de machine learning em produção.
Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e processamento distribuído (Spark/PySpark).
Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, NLP ou RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex ou equivalentes.
Conhecimento de técnicas de deep learning e NLP.
Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
Experiência construindo e publicando modelos de ML com serviços cloud-native.
Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Informações da Empresa:

Na Ideen unimos tecnologia e estratégia para transformar desafios complexos em soluções que geram impacto real para grandes empresas.

Somos um time movido por inovação, estratégia e resultados.

Se busca um ambiente com autonomia, desafios relevantes e oportunidades reais de crescimento, a Ideen pode ser o próximo passo da sua jornada.
