Title: Senior Consultant - AI & Advanced Technology
Description:
Senior Consultant - AI & Advanced technology

Risk Consulting is looking for candidate to join our Risk Advanced Technology team as Senior Consultant based in Rome for a hybrid role.

Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk, a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments (Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer).

The Risk Advanced Technology practice develops innovative risk management services using advanced technologies (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Mining, and Business Intelligence) to support leading public and private organizations.

We count on you to:


Support clients in developing integrated risk management frameworks and in the digital transformation of risk management processes;
Analyze, map, and redesign business processes to identify inefficiencies, pain points, control gaps, and automation opportunities, with a particular focus on AI-enabled transformation initiatives;
Support clients in the assessment and reengineering of operational and control processes, leveraging AI, process mining, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics solutions. Gather and formalize business and functional requirements, translating client needs into actionable process improvement roadmaps and technology-enabled solutions;
Contribute to the design and implementation of AI use cases aimed at improving process efficiency, strengthening controls, reducing manual activities, and enhancing decision-making;
Work closely with business, risk, compliance, audit, and technology stakeholders to ensure that process transformation initiatives are aligned with governance, regulatory, and internal control requirements;
Support the execution of diagnostic assessments, gap analyses, and target operating model designs in the context of business transformation and innovation programs;
Contribute to project delivery across the full lifecycle, from current-state analysis and solution design to implementation support, testing, go-live, and change management;
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the development of internal methodologies, assets, and thought leadership on AI-driven process transformation;
Build Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions for dynamic reporting, risk monitoring dashboards, and early warning systems;
Interact with clients and all stakeholders involved in the projects, presenting results and strategic recommendations clearly and effectively.


What you need to have: 


Master’s degree or higher in Management or Industrial Engineering, with excellent academic results;
Proven experience in consulting projects with proven expertise in the following areas:

Good understanding of AI-enabled business transformation, including the application of Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, process mining, or analytics to improve business processes
Consulting projects focused on business process analysis, process reengineering, operating model review, or transformation initiative
Solid experience in gathering business and functional requirements, process mapping, drafting functional specifications, and supporting the implementation of technology-driven solutions
Experience in interacting with multiple stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and presenting complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management attitude, attention to detail, and ability to manage workstreams autonomously in a client-facing environment
Excellent knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with process mapping and workflow documentation tools is a plus
Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken


What makes you stand out:


Experience in AI transformation projects with a specific focus on process optimization, redesign, governance, and adoption
Knowledge of LLM models: prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration of AI agents and copilots, evaluation of model performance, and application of guardrails and governance mechanisms to ensure reliability, explainability, and compliance in business processes
Experience in internal controls, internal audit, compliance, or assurance-related projects, as well as familiarity with the most widely used risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, COSO Framework), with the ability to connect process reengineering initiatives to control frameworks and verification needs
Knowledge of process mining tools and methodologies for identifying bottlenecks, deviations, and improvement opportunities
Familiarity with risk and control frameworks, governance models, and operating models in regulated or complex environments
Experience in projects involving the review of end-to-end processes within finance, operations, procurement, compliance, or risk functions
Knowledge of low-code / no-code and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, Power Automate) and their use in process transformation initiatives
Relevant certifications in process improvement, project management, audit, or risk management
Knowledge of advanced Data Visualization tools (Power BI, DAX, Qlik) and Data Management tools (e.g., Azure, SQL, SAS)


Why join our team:


An international, cross-business network with leaders in Strategy, Risk, and People professional services
The opportunity to design and apply innovative risk solutions in practice for use by the Italian Public Administration (e.g., central government bodies and public-owned companies) and the private sector


What we offer:


The position is offered on a permanent basis.
We propose a gross annual salary starting from € 32.000 for a full-time position. Depending on experience, skills and qualifications, we are willing to consider compensation above the starting salary. Variable remuneration may be granted in accordance with company policy. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract.
The National Collective Bargaining Agreement (NCBA) applied is "Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi”. The contractual level, together with the applicable terms and conditions, will be determined in line with the experience and professional profile of the candidate selected through the recruitment process.
Attractive benefits offered, including insurance coverages, supplementary pension plan, facultative health assistance, meal vouchers, flexible benefits, optional stock purchase plan, smart working policy, learning programs and well-being initiatives. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

1 October 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 Central European Time (Rome)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.

ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.

At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?


WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).


BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

The Economic and Markets Unit (PRGFE) of the Food Security and Nutrition Analysis Service of the Programme Division (PRGF) of the World Food Programme (WFP) seeks to fill an economist position, which will be based at the Headquarters of the United Nations World Food Programme in Rome, Italy.

The PRGF Service in WFP Headquarters leads WFP’s food security analysis, supporting a large network of analysts in Global Headquarters (GHQ) and Country Offices (COs). Food security analysis is a cornerstone of the organization’s work. It provides WFP, governments and partners with the essential information to identify populations in need and target the most appropriate type and scale of interventions as well as with the necessary knowledge to inform policy decisions and advocacy efforts. Analyses span emergency assessments, in-depth household surveys, food security monitoring, early warning and forecasting, spatial analysis and economic and market analysis.

PRGFE combines expertise in market systems, operational efficiency, economic modelling, and strategic analytics to provide economic and market analysis and cross-cutting strategic and analytical support for operational decision-making and evidence-driven advocacy. The unit provides tools, guidance, and support to WFP COs to enhance their capacity to monitor food prices, assess markets, analyse essential needs and adjust programmes in contexts of economic shocks, ensuring that interventions are both timely and effective. PRGFE further monitors economic trends and risks, analyses food security implications of global economic shocks and runs scenario simulations, based on cutting-edge economic research.

Within the unit, the Economist will provide senior technical leadership across WFP’s economic and market analysis, developing and applying advanced methods (economic modelling, scenario simulation, demand analysis, composite indices and market assessment) that turn complex, multi-source data into credible, timely evidence for decision-making. The purpose is to strengthen WFP’s capacity to anticipate and respond to the economic shocks and market conditions affecting food security, directing resources where they most effectively alleviate hunger and malnutrition. As needs evolve, the Economist will design and validate new methods and tools and bring them into operational use at scale.

The Economist will also provide technical supervision and on-demand research advice and country support across other unit initiatives.

ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under the supervision of the Head of PRGFE, the Economist will specifically undertake the following tasks:


Lead global economic modelling that quantifies how major shocks (including armed conflict, energy and commodity price spikes, macroeconomic crises) transmit to food security worldwide, producing the evidence base for WFP’s strategic prioritization, response and advocacy;
Lead country-level demand and scenario analysis that models how households and local economies respond to shocks and to assistance, and develop, validate and scale these methods so that timely evidence reaches operational decision-makers;
Develop composite indices and analytical metrics that rank country needs, guide the allocation of funding, and inform resource prioritization and corporate early warning;
Lead the development of market assessment tools and methodologies, spanning market functionality and the availability and affordability of nutritious foods, to inform cash-based transfer and nutrition-sensitive operations;
Design and validate new analytical methods, indicators and tools as WFP’s economic and market analysis needs evolve, bringing them into operational use at scale;
Set technical direction and advisory support for collecting, integrating, modelling and visualizing economic and market data within PRGF’s data ecosystems, and for the tools that turn them into decision-ready evidence;
Support PRGF Service’s efforts on economic analysis and research on food security and its policy implications;
Lead capacity strengthening in economic and market analysis for WFP CO staff as well as to partners;
Contribute to resource mobilization, including securing sustainable funding for analytical tools and drafting funding proposals or section thereof;
Supervise and mentor other team members;
Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Education:


Advanced degree (MSc) in economics, agricultural or development economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline, with strong formal training in econometrics and economic modelling. A PhD in Economics is an advantage.


Experience:


At least 8 years of progressively responsible professional experience across macro- and micro-economics, market assessments, food security and vulnerability analysis, emergency needs assessment, and quantitative and econometric analysis in humanitarian or development operations.
Extensive field experience designing and conducting market and price surveys in challenging operating environments, including in remote and hard-to-access settings.
Demonstrated record of developing analytical tools, indicators or models, rooted in field experience, that have been validated and adopted at scale across multiple country operations, including a peer-reviewed publication record evidencing methodological rigour and the ability to publish validation studies.
Experience designing and delivering training and capacity strengthening on economic and market analysis, and leading methodological collaborations across academic, institutional and private-sector partners.
Experience with food security and emergency operations, in management and inter-agency coordination, and in resource mobilisation, including the development of funding proposals, is desirable.


Knowledge & Skills:


Exceptional analytical and conceptual skills, able to turn complex data into clear evidence for decision-makers.
Strong econometric and modelling skills, including applied micro-econometrics across cross-sectional, panel and time-series data, and economic modelling for policy analysis, consumer demand analysis, price and income elasticities, and the micro-macro linkages needed to trace how shocks reach households, markets and food security.
Questionnaire design, sampling, enumerator training and data-quality control for market and price surveys.
Strong writing skills with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, concise analytical briefs and publications.
Advanced command of at least one statistical computing environment (e.g. Stata, Python or R), with proficiency across more than one an asset; good command of MS Office.
Proven ability to build and maintain automated, reproducible pipelines over large, multi-source datasets (price, market, household, assistance, climate), for both analysis and data visualisation.
Experience with cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS, GCP) and version control (e.g. Git).
Problem-solving attitude and creativity.
Ability to work both with minimal supervision and as part of a team, including supervising staff.
Ability to establish effective working relations with people of different national and cultural backgrounds.


Languages:


Fluent written and spoken English (level C)
Working knowledge (level B) of French, Arabic or Spanish is an advantage

Title: AI Engineering, Intern (Milan / Rome)
Description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 




WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture, and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted. 




WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The AI Engineering Intern will contribute to the design and development of generative AI applications and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. Working alongside experienced engineers, consultants, and data scientists, you will gain hands-on exposure to the full AI development lifecycle—from early prototyping through to production-ready deployment. This is a learning-first role: you will grow through real project work, close mentorship, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities. As an intern, you will build the technical core of transformations and help move solutions from prototype to real adoption. You will have opportunities to collaborate with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, contributing to real client deployments and shaping how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to the design and development of GenAI applications (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, decision support) using modern LLM stacks.
Support the implementation of AI pipelines and components, including:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
Embedding generation and optimization
Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
Assist in implementing tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
Assist in building agent capabilities including context engineering, memory and state management, orchestration, and tool integration
Support model experimentation, evaluation design, and production deployment tasks alongside senior team members
Write clean, testable code and contribute to APIs and services through the full SDLC: build, test, deploy, monitor, iterate
Contribute to evaluation and observability for GenAI systems: regression test suites, automated scoring, and prompt or policy iteration loops
Gain exposure to responsible AI practices across system design, including:
Implementing guardrails, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
Understanding Bain’s Responsible AI standards and supporting alignment in your work
Contribute to evaluation harnesses and reusable components that scale across client contexts
Contribute to ML solutions end-to-end, including:
Data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, and training
Validation, testing, and performance analysis
Applying appropriate ML methods spanning classical ML and deep learning
Developing working knowledge of transformer fundamentals and LLM concepts
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teammates to build well-structured, reliable AI systems
Communicate clearly in working sessions, demos, and documentation—with both technical and non-technical audiences
Support client discussions and documentation as part of broader engagement teams

ABOUT YOU

0–2+ years of professional AI / ML engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, research, academic projects, or open-source contributions
Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in CS, ML, AI, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent early-career experience
Strong academic performance or demonstrated excellence through research, projects, internships, competitions, or open-source contributions
Proficiency in Python and some experience building APIs or services (e.g., REST/gRPC), or comparable project-based experience
Experience building complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
Exposure to retrieval and search systems (e.g., vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking) and familiarity with structured and unstructured data stores
Exposure to agentic patterns (context management, tool integration, orchestration, memory/state handling); hands-on experience preferred
Strong engineering practices: testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, and performance profiling
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; interest in applying AI to real-world business problems in a client-facing environment
Fluency in English and Italian is required

Working Model & Travel 

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office. 
Travel may be required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.







In accordance with applicable Italian pay transparency requirements, Bain & Company provides information regarding the compensation applicable to this position. The salary for this role in Italy is €1500 gross per month




This compensation information has been determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria and reflects the compensation normally applicable to the position at the time of publication. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and the scope of responsibilities associated with the role.




This position is subject to the provisions of the following Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL):Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per i lavoratori addetti all’industria metalmeccanica e della installazione di impianti

Title: Junior SAP AI Consultant (Intern)
Description:
We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Do Work That Matters – Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l'opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse.

KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché nel supporto alle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.

Entrando a far parte del Team Enterprise Platform, sarai inserita/o in un percorso di crescita nell'ambito SAP AI, affiancando consulenti senior nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale applicate ai processi aziendali ed ecosistemi ERP.

Nello specifico ti occuperai di:


Supportare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di soluzioni AI e Generative AI applicate a processi aziendali e sistemi ERP
Approfondire le principali piattaforme e framework AI, affiancando i colleghi senior nell'implementazione
Contribuire allo sviluppo di AI Agent, Copilot aziendali, chatbot e soluzioni basate su architetture RAG
Supportare l'integrazione di soluzioni AI con sistemi ERP, CRM e applicazioni enterprise tramite API e servizi di integrazione
Partecipare ad attività di analisi dei processi aziendali e identificazione di opportunità di automazione intelligente
Collaborare alla raccolta di requisiti funzionali e alla stesura della documentazione di progetto


Come As You Are – Le tue competenze e caratteristiche

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:


Sei laureata/o o in procinto di laurearti in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline affini
Hai acquisito conoscenze di base di Intelligenza Artificiale e Machine Learning durante il percorso di studi, la tesi o progetti personali
Conosci almeno un linguaggio di programmazione, preferibilmente Python
Sei curiosa/o rispetto ai principi della Generative AI (modelli linguistici, prompt engineering), anche solo a livello di studio o approfondimento personale
Hai interesse verso i sistemi ERP, preferibilmente SAP, senza necessità di conoscenza pregressa
Hai buone capacità di analisi logica e problem solving, spirito di squadra e voglia di imparare
Possiedi una buona padronanza della lingua inglese e attitudine al lavoro in team
Sei disponibile a trasferte in Italia e all'estero in base alle esigenze progettuali


Un plus: tesi, progetti universitari, hackathon o certificazioni base in ambito AI, Cloud o Data (Microsoft, Google, AWS o simili), anche conseguite in autonomia.

Your Future With Us – Cosa troverai in KPMG


Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed equo, che rispetta e valorizza la diversità
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che favorisce creatività e lavoro di squadra
Un modello di hybrid working che promuove un sano equilibrio vita-lavoro
Programmi avanzati di formazione e sviluppo per tenere sempre aggiornate le tue competenze
Una mentalità internazionale e progetti innovativi
Iniziative dedicate al benessere fisico e mentale


L'opportunità prevede un inserimento in stage con indennità mensile di 800€ per stage curriculare o 1.000€ per stage extracurriculare o in assunzione con inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio e RAL di ingresso: € 29.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali il titolo di studio e la valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.

Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno

Leadership, lavoro di squadra, rispetto per ogni individuo, apprendimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità e integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG, che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e conoscenze, permettendo alle nostre professioniste e ai nostri professionisti di esprimere il proprio pieno potenziale.

Attraverso il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network rispetta i requisiti della norma ISO 30415 (Diversity & Inclusion Management System) e UNI PdR 125 (parità di genere). All'interno del nostro Impact Plan troverai una sintesi di tutte le azioni che stiamo intraprendendo sui temi ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance).

Unisciti a noi!

I dati personali saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto del Regolamento UE n. 679/2016 (GDPR) e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, si rimanda all'informativa privacy di KPMG.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce pari opportunità.

Do Work That Matters – Your Role And Responsibilities

Do you want to do work that truly matters and makes an impact? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and colleagues face and solve today's most current and complex challenges.

KPMG Advisory provides consulting services to businesses, supporting them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitalisation, risk analysis and management, as well as extraordinary finance operations.

Joining the Enterprise Platform Team, you will be onboarded onto a growth path within SAP AI, working alongside senior consultants on the design and development of Artificial Intelligence solutions applied to business processes and ERP ecosystems.

Specifically, you will:


Support the design and development of AI and Generative AI solutions applied to business processes and ERP systems
Deepen your knowledge of the main AI platforms and frameworks, working alongside senior colleagues on implementation
Contribute to the development of AI Agents, enterprise Copilots, chatbots, and solutions based on RAG architectures
Support the integration of AI solutions with ERP, CRM, and enterprise applications through APIs and integration services
Take part in business process analysis activities and identify opportunities for intelligent automation
Collaborate on gathering functional requirements and drafting project documentation


Come As You Are – Your Skills And Background

This opportunity is right for you if:


You hold or are completing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
You have gained basic knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning through your studies, thesis, or personal projects
You know at least one programming language, preferably Python
You are curious about Generative AI principles (language models, prompt engineering), even if only through independent study
You have an interest in ERP systems, preferably SAP, with no prior experience required
You have good logical analysis and problem-solving skills, a team-oriented mindset, and a genuine willingness to learn
Good command of English, written and spoken
You are available for business travel in Italy and abroad based on project needs


A plus: thesis work, university projects, hackathons, or entry-level certifications in AI, Cloud, or Data (Microsoft, Google, AWS, or similar), even self-obtained.

Your Future With Us – What You Will Find at KPMG


An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects and celebrates diversity
A stimulating and dynamic setting that encourages creativity and teamwork
A hybrid working model that promotes a healthy work-life balance
Advanced training and development programmes to keep your skills sharp
An international mindset and innovative project portfolio
Initiatives focused on physical and mental wellbeing


This opportunity is offered as either a paid internship offering a monthly allowance of €800 for curricular internships and €1,000 for extracurricular internships or a standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate's profile against the requirements of the role.

In compliance with applicable law, we do not collect or use information about salaries received in current or previous employment relationships. Our selection processes are also based on objective and gender neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our Values and Our Commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, community engagement, and integrity: these are the Values of KPMG, which give life to an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, enabling our professionals to reach their full potential.

Through our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace, our Network complies with the ISO 30415 standard (Diversity & Inclusion Management System) and UNI PdR 125 (Gender Equality). Within our Impact Plan, you will find a full overview of the actions we are taking on ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) topics.

Join us!

Title: Senior Climate Risk & Adaptation Specialist
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior da inserire nel team Climate & Adaptation di Deloitte Climate & Sustainability nella sede di Milano/ Roma, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

Il team Climate & Adaptation di Deloitte Climate & Sustainability supporta aziende e istituzioni nel misurare e gestire i rischi climatici fisici e di transizione e nel definire e valutare i piani di adattamento. Lavoriamo su analisi di scenario, modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità, stima del danno e valutazioni economico-finanziarie degli interventi di adattamento, traducendo dati complessi in decisioni operative. Operiamo in progetti data-driven con forte componente tecnica e di sviluppo di strumenti e modelli.

Your Role

La Risorsa Sarà Inserita In Un Team Multidisciplinare Con Un Ruolo Tecnico-specialistico Sulle Analisi Di Rischio Climatico Fisico e Adattamento, e Si Occuperà Di


Condurre analisi di rischio climatico fisico a livello di asset e di portafoglio, elaborando dataset climatici e geospaziali, stimando indicatori di hazard, esposizione e danno economico atteso, ed estendendo l'analisi al rischio di transizione
Sviluppare e calibrare curve di vulnerabilità asset-specific traducendo l'esposizione fisica in impatto economico concreto (danno diretto e indiretto, business interruption)
Identificare le misure di adattamento e i relativi business case (valutazione degli interventi, danno evitato, prioritizzazione delle azioni di resilienza), confrontandosi con gli ingegneri per il dimensionamento tecnico
Sviluppare workflow riproducibili in Python/R e tradurre i risultati in output e implicazioni di business per il cliente, con possibilità di guidare risorse più junior.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa EUR 39.000 e EUR 46.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Fisica, Scienze ambientali/climatiche, Data Science o STEM affini, e oltre 4-5 anni di esperienza in climate risk, modellistica del rischio fisico o adattamento (in caso di dottorato in ambito climatico, gli anni di esperienza saranno valutati caso per caso)
Ottima padronanza di Python e, preferibilmente, R, con familiarità con dati e strumenti geospaziali (netCDF/GRIB, raster, GIS) e workflow riproducibili
Competenza nella modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità e nella stima del danno: curve di vulnerabilità, downscaling e bias correction, scenari climatici (IPCC, RCP/SSP)
Solida conoscenza della statistica per il rischio (distribuzioni, teoria dei valori estremi, simulazioni Monte Carlo)
Inglese fluente, autonomia nella conduzione delle analisi, attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari e capacità di comunicare risultati complessi a stakeholder non tecnici


To Make An Impact That Matters

Deloitte opera in Italia dal 1923 ed è un punto di riferimento per imprese e istituzioni nei servizi professionali, coniugando l’expertise internazionale del network con una profonda conoscenza del contesto economico e normativo nazionale. Al 31 maggio 2025, Deloitte in Italia conta 15.000 professioniste e professionisti, un fatturato superiore a 1,7 miliardi di euro e una presenza capillare in 23 città sul territorio. Attraverso un’offerta multidisciplinare, supporta organizzazioni di diverse dimensioni e settori nell’affrontare trasformazioni complesse, dalla digitalizzazione alla sostenibilità, rispondendo alle crescenti esigenze di investitori, istituzioni e stakeholder. I servizi includono Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

  • Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Fisica, Scienze ambientali/climatiche, Data Science o STEM affini, e oltre 4-5 anni di esperienza in climate risk, modellistica del rischio fisico o adattamento (in caso di dottorato in ambito climatico, gli anni di esperienza saranno valutati caso per caso)
  • Ottima padronanza di Python e, preferibilmente, R, con familiarità con dati e strumenti geospaziali (netCDF/GRIB, raster, GIS) e workflow riproducibili
  • Competenza nella modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità e nella stima del danno: curve di vulnerabilità, downscaling e bias correction, scenari climatici (IPCC, RCP/SSP)
  • Solida conoscenza della statistica per il rischio (distribuzioni, teoria dei valori estremi, simulazioni Monte Carlo)
  • Inglese fluente, autonomia nella conduzione delle analisi, attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari e capacità di comunicare risultati complessi a stakeholder non tecnici

To Make An Impact That Matters

Deloitte opera in Italia dal 1923 ed è un punto di riferimento per imprese e istituzioni nei servizi professionali, coniugando l’expertise internazionale del network con una profonda conoscenza del contesto economico e normativo nazionale. Al 31 maggio 2025, Deloitte in Italia conta 15.000 professioniste e professionisti, un fatturato superiore a 1,7 miliardi di euro e una presenza capillare in 23 città sul territorio. Attraverso un’offerta multidisciplinare, supporta organizzazioni di diverse dimensioni e settori nell’affrontare trasformazioni complesse, dalla digitalizzazione alla sostenibilità, rispondendo alle crescenti esigenze di investitori, istituzioni e stakeholder. I servizi includono Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

Title: Operations Research & Optimization Specialist
Description:
Entrando in Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering lavorerai al cuore della value chain - dal sourcing e procurement, all'engineering e R&D, dalla manifattura e operations, ai capital projects - per aiutare le aziende a reinventare l'intera catena del valore, alimentata da dati, AI e tecnologie di nuova generazione.

In particolare, nell’area Manufacturing & Operations accompagnerai i clienti nella trasformazione dei processi produttivi, attraverso automazione, tecnologie avanzate e Physical AI. Ottimizzerai fabbriche e operations rendendole più connesse, efficienti e resilienti, grazie all'utilizzo di dati, AI e sistemi intelligenti capaci di agire nel mondo fisico.

Entrerai nel team Robotics & Automation, contribuendo allo sviluppo di soluzioni di Operations Research, Optimization e Physical AI per migliorare l'efficienza, la resilienza e le performance delle operations industriali.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue attività



Sviluppare modelli di Operations Research e Mathematical Optimization per planning, scheduling, routing e ottimizzazione delle operations

Tradurre esigenze di business e vincoli operativi in modelli matematici e soluzioni algoritmiche avanzate

Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni in Python, utilizzando framework e solver di ottimizzazione

Collaborare con team di AI, Data & Automation per realizzare soluzioni end-to-end, dal PoC alla messa in produzione

Applicare tecniche di ottimizzazione a contesti di Physical AI e Robotica, inclusi motion planning e generazione di traiettorie

Analizzare processi produttivi e flussi operativi, identificando opportunità di miglioramento e ottimizzazione



La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui - ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B2 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico.

La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra € 28.099 e € 34.600.

Le tue caratteristiche



Laurea magistrale in Matematica, Ricerca Operativa, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science, Informatica o Ingegneria (Gestionale, Automazione, Industriale o affini)

Esperienza nella modellazione matematica e nell'utilizzo di tecniche quali Linear Programming (LP), Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP), Constraint Programming, Non Linear Programming e Convex Optimization

Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle principali librerie per data handling e calcolo numerico (Pandas, NumPy, Polars)

Esperienza con framework e solver di ottimizzazione quali OR-Tools, Pyomo, PuLP, Gurobi o CPLEX

Familiarità con strumenti di sviluppo quali Git, SQL e Docker; la conoscenza di piattaforme Cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) rappresenta un plus

Human/machine dialog

Systems Analysis

You have knowledge of cybersecurity

You can confidently discuss with people from different jobs and background

You master foundational concepts in mathematics/ statistics science and their application to deploy them on Solution studies: statistical modelling, linear algebra, optimisation, machine learning Mathematics and Statistics

NICE TO HAVE:


Working heritage on major satellite Earth Observation and Navigation systems
Simulation by tool such as Matlab & Simulink
adopting modern Agile and DevOps processes

Good knowledge of operating systems;

Room and attention to personal development

Title: AI Developer - Roma [DIG]
HTML:
Trasforma le tue aspirazioni professionali in una storia di successo, entra in PwC come AI Developer.

 

Your Perspectives

 

Entra a far parte del nostro team Digital Innovation - AI Center of Excellence in rapida crescita e partecipa allo sviluppo di rivoluzionarie applicazioni basate su tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale. Avrai l’opportunità di:

  • Sviluppare progetti basati su algoritmi di intelligenza artificiale, sia per ottimizzazioni dei processi interni o per clienti che integrati in innovative soluzioni software;

  • Contribuire attivamente alla crescita della nostra struttura dedicata all'Intelligenza Artificiale, in particolare al Natural Language Understanding e alla Computer Vision;

  • Partecipare al ciclo di vita di un prodotto basato su AI, dall’analisi del business case, al tuning dei modelli, allo sviluppo delle componenti applicative richieste dall’applicazione fino alla realizzazione della User Experience ideale;

  • Muoverti in un contesto organizzato, dove gli aspetti metodologici e di relazione assumono una rilevanza strategica con respiro internazionale e multiculturale;

  • Operare in un contesto organizzato, dove gli aspetti metodologici e di relazione assumono una rilevanza strategica con respiro internazionale e multiculturale;

  • Garantire l’erogazione dei deliverables di progetto concordati con il Project Manager di riferimento e con i committenti, in accordo con i vincoli di budget e quality condivisi;

  • Fornire supporto applicativo a soluzioni basate su moduli di Intelligenza Artificiale, Large Language Models e Computer Vision, sia esistenti che di nuova realizzazione.

 

Your unique strengths

  • Possiedi una laurea in discipline STEM;

  • Hai esperienza nello sviluppo e addestramento di modelli utilizzando tecniche di Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing e Computer Vision, sia a partire dai framework più utilizzati (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Spark ML, Spark GraphX) che da servizi SaaS (Google Vertex AI, Azure Cognitive Services, OpenAI);

  • Hai esperienza nell'utilizzo di Python per lo sviluppo di soluzioni basate su AI e sei interessato a lavorare con Large Language Models come OpenAI e tecniche di Computer Vision come OCR, YoLo, etc.;

  • Hai basi di Semantic Web e conosci l’architettura dei motori di ricerca evoluti (Elastic Search, Solr, Lucene);

  • Hai utilizzato strutture dati NoSQL (MongoDB o componenti dell'ecosistema Hadoop);

  • Conosci approfonditamente linguaggi di programmazione object oriented come Java/Scala, C++ o Python;

  • Sei capace di mettere in pratica tecniche di "Continuous Learning" al fine di cogliere opportunità da nuove tecnologie senza abbandonarti alla sola attività di ricerca;

  • Possiedi tecniche di ascolto attivo, capacità di sintesi e di problem solving;

  • Ti contraddistingui per intraprendenza e curiosità, spiccato senso di responsabilità professionale;

  • Possiedi una conoscenza avanzata della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta).

Set your expectation higher

PwC ti sorprenderà con un’opportunità di carriera che ti farà sentire al centro della società, dell’innovazione e del cambiamento. Il tuo talento e la tua curiosità avranno tutto lo spazio che meritano e, attraverso l’identificazione delle migliori risorse, contribuirai a garantire la qualità dei servizi che offriamo ai nostri clienti. In questo percorso di crescita sarai accompagnato da colleghi esperti e da una formazione continua e su misura grazie alla quale potrai mettere le tue competenze a disposizione dei clienti interni.

 

Feel at home

Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre persone, abbracciando le diversità e creando valore per i clienti, le persone e la comunità, nel rispetto dell'ambiente.

GIVE YOUR LIFE A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE

Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto al:

  • 3° livello CCNL Commercio (28.000€-30.000€) per candidati senza esperienza o esperienza minima

  • 2° livello CCNL Commercio (31.500€-32.500€) per candidati con comprovata esperienza nel ruolo


L'offerta finale sarà definita anche in base alla valutazione delle tue competenze ed esperienze pregresse.

Entrare in PwC significa anche poter contare su un ecosistema di iniziative e benefit pensati per supportare benessere, crescita e work-life integration.
Il pacchetto include:

  • Buoni pasto del valore di 8€

  • Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, estendibile ai familiari

  • Piano welfare dedicato

  • Programmi e iniziative di wellbeing

  • Convenzioni

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
All’interno del team Chief Strategy, Business Development and Wholebuy Office – Competence Development Center, ricerchiamo una persona da inserire nel ruolo di Business Data Analyst motivata e con un forte approccio analitico, da inserire presso la nostra sede di Roma.

Attività previste dal ruolo:

La persona individuata si occuperà di analizzare e interpretare dati provenienti da diverse fonti aziendali, sviluppando soluzioni di analisi e monitoraggio a supporto delle decisioni di business e contribuendo all’automazione e all’industrializzazione dei processi di elaborazione dei dati.

In particolare, la risorsa sarà coinvolta in:


Definizione degli scope progettuali e traduzione delle esigenze di business in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Analisi di fenomeni complessi attraverso dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee.
Individuazione di KPI e metriche rilevanti per il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.
Sviluppo e automazione di processi di elaborazione, controllo e analisi dei dati.
Verifica della qualità, della coerenza e dell’affidabilità delle informazioni prima della loro condivisione con gli stakeholder.
Individuazione di anomalie nei dati e supporto alle attività di troubleshooting e riconciliazione tra fonti differenti.
Interpretazione dei risultati delle analisi, distinguendo evidenze, ipotesi e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Sviluppo autonomo di analisi, KPI e strumenti di supporto alle decisioni.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace degli insight e dei risultati analitici, anche a interlocutori non tecnici.
Gestione autonoma delle attività assegnate, in collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Tali attività saranno svolte con riferimento al processo di integrazione delle competenze funzionali al percorso di trasformazione aziendale in atto.

Requisiti richiesti:


Laurea o percorso specialistico in discipline quantitative o tecnico-scientifiche, quali Data Science, Statistica, Matematica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia quantitativa o percorsi affini.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL e capacità di lavorare con dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni.
Buona conoscenza di Python, con particolare riferimento all’analisi e alla trasformazione dei dati.
Conoscenza delle principali librerie Python per la data analysis, quali Pandas, NumPy o equivalenti.
Capacità di sviluppare processi di data preparation, aggregazione, riconciliazione e controllo qualità.
Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione del dato e delle problematiche relative a granularità, duplicazioni, join e consistenza tra fonti.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di database relazionali e/o data warehouse.
Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con strumenti quali BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Vertex AI, o con piattaforme cloud equivalenti.
Familiarità con strumenti di data visualization e dashboarding.
Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice, in particolare Git.
Conoscenza dei principi di sviluppo software, con attenzione alla leggibilità, alla modularità e alla manutenibilità del codice.
Familiarità con processi di automazione, scheduling e industrializzazione delle elaborazioni dati.
Familiarità con tecniche di prompt engineering e con strumenti low-code/no-code per la realizzazione di agenti AI e workflow basati su modelli generativi.


Competenze trasversali:


Forte capacità analitica e attitudine all’interpretazione di fenomeni complessi.
Orientamento alla qualità, all’affidabilità e alla coerenza del dato.
Capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli stakeholder e tradurle in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Autonomia nella gestione delle attività e orientamento al risultato.
Problem solving e capacità di individuare anomalie e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace, anche verso interlocutori non tecnici.
Predisposizione alla collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Titoli preferenziali:


Esperienza nello sviluppo di analisi dati a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Esperienza nella costruzione e nel monitoraggio di KPI e metriche di performance.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL in contesti progettuali o aziendali.
Esperienza nella gestione di dataset provenienti da fonti eterogenee e nelle attività di data quality e data reconciliation.
Esperienza nella realizzazione o manutenzione di dashboard e strumenti di reporting.
Familiarità con ambienti cloud, pipeline dati e processi CI/CD.


Cosa offriamo:


Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
RAL di partenza pari a 31.400€, stabilita utilizzando criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere. L’offerta economica effettiva potrà ulteriormente incrementarsi, entro parametri prestabiliti, in considerazione dell’evidenza di alcuni criteri di riferimento, quali il percorso formativo effettuato, l’esperienza professionale maturata nel ruolo e complessivamente, le certificazioni conseguite e la particolare affinità dimostrata rispetto al profilo ricercato.
Pacchetto welfare e benefit aggiuntivi.
Formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione.
Possibilità di lavorare su progetti di analisi, automazione e industrializzazione dei dati, utilizzando tecnologie cloud, strumenti di data visualization e soluzioni basate sull’intelligenza artificiale.
Opportunità di crescita in un contesto dinamico, innovativo e orientato alla trasformazione digitale.

SviluppoH è una società di ingegneria del software con sede a Roma, specializzata nell'intelligenza artificiale per organizzazioni che operano in contesti ad alta responsabilità: difesa, aerospazio, sanità, energia e pubblica amministrazione. 3+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI andate in produzione.
Solida padronanza di Python e di almeno uno tra PyTorch e TensorFlow, oltre a Hugging Face.
Esperienza concreta su progetti di Computer Vision e/o modelli linguistici.

Autonomia operativa e capacità di lavorare in team con metodo Agile.




Nice to have

Esperienza con RAG e orchestrazione di agenti.
Conoscenza di C#.
Esperienza in settori regolamentati (difesa, sanità, energia).

▪ Sede: Roma, modalità ibrida con 1/2 giorni a settimana in presenza

Realizzazione di dashboard e reportistica utilizzando Power BI e tool di data visualization (Tableau, Qlik) per estrarre approfondimenti di cui i clienti necessitano

Gradita esperienza nell’utilizzo di piattaforme dati come Microsoft Fabric e Databricks

Title: AI Solution Specialist
Description:
Il Gruppo Almaviva leader italiano nell’Information & Communication Technology, accompagna i processi di crescita del Paese raccogliendo la sfida che le realtà enterprise devono affrontare per rimanere competitive nell’era del digitale. Da solide competenze Made in Italy, unite alla capacità di integrare culture, intelligenze ed esperienze diverse, è nato un network globale.

Posizione:

Entrerai a far parte della Direzione Global AI Business Development & Innovation nel ruolo di AI Solution Specialist, contribuendo all’evoluzione del posizionamento strategico e del portafoglio di offerta del Gruppo sui temi dell’Intelligenza Artificiale. Avrai il compito di analizzare i portafogli di offerta dei diversi mercati aziendali, individuando e proponendo nuove soluzioni, funzionalità e use case AI coerenti con le esigenze dei clienti, con l’evoluzione tecnologica e con il posizionamento del Gruppo. Il ruolo opererà in stretta collaborazione con i laboratori di Prodotto, i team di Innovazione Digitale, le strutture di Marketing, Pre-sales e Bid Office, contribuendo alla predisposizione delle offerte tecniche per gare, bandi di ricerca e opportunità commerciali.

In particolare, avrai le seguenti responsabilità:


Innovazione e Differenziazione dell’Offerta: definire gli elementi innovativi e distintivi delle proposte individuando tecnologie emergenti, modelli e componenti open-source o proprietarie, partner tecnologici e accademici e use case specialistici di dominio, valutarne maturità, prestazioni, licenze, rischio di lock-in e reale applicabilità nel contesto del cliente, traducendoli in fattori di vantaggio competitivo.
Solution Design e Redazione Tecnica di Gara: progettazione di soluzioni e stesura della documentazione tecnica e metodologica per risposte a bandi di gara, appalti e procurement pubblico e privato in ambito AI.
Analisi del Portafoglio e Benchmark Internazionale: analizzare il portafoglio di offerta dei diversi mercati aziendali confrontandolo con lo stato dell’arte internazionale, soluzioni dei principali system integrator e technology provider globali, piattaforme e prodotti best-in-class, casi d’uso di riferimento nei mercati più maturi.
Monitorare trend, tecnologie, piattaforme e modelli emergenti in ambito AI, Machine Learning e Generative AI, valutandone l’applicabilità ai diversi domini di mercato.
Progetti di Ricerca e Finanziamenti: Contributo alla stesura di proposte di ricerca e sviluppo per bandi di finanziamento (nazionali ed europei), curando lo stato dell’arte e l’innovatività della componente AI.



Requisiti:

Hard skills:


Esperienza Operativa su Soluzioni AI in Produzione: almeno 3 anni in ruoli tecnici hands-on (AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Engineer) con ownership end-to-end del ciclo di vita di soluzioni AI e Generative AI effettivamente rilasciate e mantenute in esercizio.
Machine Learning e Deep Learning: esperienze con tecnologie quali PyTorch e/o TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers; feature engineering, tuning e valutazione dei modelli, gestione di bias e drift, con applicazioni di NLP, Computer Vision e forecasting.

Description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

1 October 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 Central European Time (Rome)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.

ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.

At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?


WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).


BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

The Economic and Markets Unit (PRGFE) of the Food Security and Nutrition Analysis Service of the Programme Division (PRGF) of the World Food Programme (WFP) seeks to fill an economist position, which will be based at the Headquarters of the United Nations World Food Programme in Rome, Italy.

The PRGF Service in WFP Headquarters leads WFP’s food security analysis, supporting a large network of analysts in Global Headquarters (GHQ) and Country Offices (COs). Food security analysis is a cornerstone of the organization’s work. It provides WFP, governments and partners with the essential information to identify populations in need and target the most appropriate type and scale of interventions as well as with the necessary knowledge to inform policy decisions and advocacy efforts. Analyses span emergency assessments, in-depth household surveys, food security monitoring, early warning and forecasting, spatial analysis and economic and market analysis.

PRGFE combines expertise in market systems, operational efficiency, economic modelling, and strategic analytics to provide economic and market analysis and cross-cutting strategic and analytical support for operational decision-making and evidence-driven advocacy. The unit provides tools, guidance, and support to WFP COs to enhance their capacity to monitor food prices, assess markets, analyse essential needs and adjust programmes in contexts of economic shocks, ensuring that interventions are both timely and effective. PRGFE further monitors economic trends and risks, analyses food security implications of global economic shocks and runs scenario simulations, based on cutting-edge economic research.

Within the unit, the Economist will provide senior technical leadership across WFP’s economic and market analysis, developing and applying advanced methods (economic modelling, scenario simulation, demand analysis, composite indices and market assessment) that turn complex, multi-source data into credible, timely evidence for decision-making. The purpose is to strengthen WFP’s capacity to anticipate and respond to the economic shocks and market conditions affecting food security, directing resources where they most effectively alleviate hunger and malnutrition. As needs evolve, the Economist will design and validate new methods and tools and bring them into operational use at scale.

The Economist will also provide technical supervision and on-demand research advice and country support across other unit initiatives.

ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under the supervision of the Head of PRGFE, the Economist will specifically undertake the following tasks:


Lead global economic modelling that quantifies how major shocks (including armed conflict, energy and commodity price spikes, macroeconomic crises) transmit to food security worldwide, producing the evidence base for WFP’s strategic prioritization, response and advocacy;
Lead country-level demand and scenario analysis that models how households and local economies respond to shocks and to assistance, and develop, validate and scale these methods so that timely evidence reaches operational decision-makers;
Develop composite indices and analytical metrics that rank country needs, guide the allocation of funding, and inform resource prioritization and corporate early warning;
Lead the development of market assessment tools and methodologies, spanning market functionality and the availability and affordability of nutritious foods, to inform cash-based transfer and nutrition-sensitive operations;
Design and validate new analytical methods, indicators and tools as WFP’s economic and market analysis needs evolve, bringing them into operational use at scale;
Set technical direction and advisory support for collecting, integrating, modelling and visualizing economic and market data within PRGF’s data ecosystems, and for the tools that turn them into decision-ready evidence;
Support PRGF Service’s efforts on economic analysis and research on food security and its policy implications;
Lead capacity strengthening in economic and market analysis for WFP CO staff as well as to partners;
Contribute to resource mobilization, including securing sustainable funding for analytical tools and drafting funding proposals or section thereof;
Supervise and mentor other team members;
Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Education:


Advanced degree (MSc) in economics, agricultural or development economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline, with strong formal training in econometrics and economic modelling. A PhD in Economics is an advantage.


Experience:


At least 8 years of progressively responsible professional experience across macro- and micro-economics, market assessments, food security and vulnerability analysis, emergency needs assessment, and quantitative and econometric analysis in humanitarian or development operations.
Extensive field experience designing and conducting market and price surveys in challenging operating environments, including in remote and hard-to-access settings.
Demonstrated record of developing analytical tools, indicators or models, rooted in field experience, that have been validated and adopted at scale across multiple country operations, including a peer-reviewed publication record evidencing methodological rigour and the ability to publish validation studies.
Experience designing and delivering training and capacity strengthening on economic and market analysis, and leading methodological collaborations across academic, institutional and private-sector partners.
Experience with food security and emergency operations, in management and inter-agency coordination, and in resource mobilisation, including the development of funding proposals, is desirable.


Knowledge & Skills:


Exceptional analytical and conceptual skills, able to turn complex data into clear evidence for decision-makers.
Strong econometric and modelling skills, including applied micro-econometrics across cross-sectional, panel and time-series data, and economic modelling for policy analysis, consumer demand analysis, price and income elasticities, and the micro-macro linkages needed to trace how shocks reach households, markets and food security.
Questionnaire design, sampling, enumerator training and data-quality control for market and price surveys.
Strong writing skills with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, concise analytical briefs and publications.
Advanced command of at least one statistical computing environment (e.g. Stata, Python or R), with proficiency across more than one an asset; good command of MS Office.
Proven ability to build and maintain automated, reproducible pipelines over large, multi-source datasets (price, market, household, assistance, climate), for both analysis and data visualisation.
Experience with cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS, GCP) and version control (e.g. Git).
Problem-solving attitude and creativity.
Ability to work both with minimal supervision and as part of a team, including supervising staff.
Ability to establish effective working relations with people of different national and cultural backgrounds.


Languages:


Fluent written and spoken English (level C)
Working knowledge (level B) of French, Arabic or Spanish is an advantage

Title: AI Engineering, Intern (Milan / Rome)
Description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 




WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture, and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted. 




WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The AI Engineering Intern will contribute to the design and development of generative AI applications and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. Working alongside experienced engineers, consultants, and data scientists, you will gain hands-on exposure to the full AI development lifecycle—from early prototyping through to production-ready deployment. This is a learning-first role: you will grow through real project work, close mentorship, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities. As an intern, you will build the technical core of transformations and help move solutions from prototype to real adoption. You will have opportunities to collaborate with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, contributing to real client deployments and shaping how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to the design and development of GenAI applications (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, decision support) using modern LLM stacks.
Support the implementation of AI pipelines and components, including:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
Embedding generation and optimization
Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
Assist in implementing tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
Assist in building agent capabilities including context engineering, memory and state management, orchestration, and tool integration
Support model experimentation, evaluation design, and production deployment tasks alongside senior team members
Write clean, testable code and contribute to APIs and services through the full SDLC: build, test, deploy, monitor, iterate
Contribute to evaluation and observability for GenAI systems: regression test suites, automated scoring, and prompt or policy iteration loops
Gain exposure to responsible AI practices across system design, including:
Implementing guardrails, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
Understanding Bain’s Responsible AI standards and supporting alignment in your work
Contribute to evaluation harnesses and reusable components that scale across client contexts
Contribute to ML solutions end-to-end, including:
Data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, and training
Validation, testing, and performance analysis
Applying appropriate ML methods spanning classical ML and deep learning
Developing working knowledge of transformer fundamentals and LLM concepts
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teammates to build well-structured, reliable AI systems
Communicate clearly in working sessions, demos, and documentation—with both technical and non-technical audiences
Support client discussions and documentation as part of broader engagement teams

ABOUT YOU

0–2+ years of professional AI / ML engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, research, academic projects, or open-source contributions
Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in CS, ML, AI, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent early-career experience
Strong academic performance or demonstrated excellence through research, projects, internships, competitions, or open-source contributions
Proficiency in Python and some experience building APIs or services (e.g., REST/gRPC), or comparable project-based experience
Experience building complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
Exposure to retrieval and search systems (e.g., vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking) and familiarity with structured and unstructured data stores
Exposure to agentic patterns (context management, tool integration, orchestration, memory/state handling); hands-on experience preferred
Strong engineering practices: testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, and performance profiling
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; interest in applying AI to real-world business problems in a client-facing environment
Fluency in English and Italian is required

Working Model & Travel 

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office. 
Travel may be required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.







In accordance with applicable Italian pay transparency requirements, Bain & Company provides information regarding the compensation applicable to this position. The salary for this role in Italy is €1500 gross per month




This compensation information has been determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria and reflects the compensation normally applicable to the position at the time of publication. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and the scope of responsibilities associated with the role.




This position is subject to the provisions of the following Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL):Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per i lavoratori addetti all’industria metalmeccanica e della installazione di impianti

Esperienza con robot legged o umanoidi (Unitree, Boston Dynamics, Agility, Figure)

Esperienza con GPU computing (CUDA) e deployment su edge devices (Jetson)
Background in ambienti industriali o cantieristici

Title: Business Analyst Data & AI - IDP
Description:
Sede di assunzione: Roma

Hai esperienza in progetti di Data Platform, Data Science o Artificial Intelligence come figura funzionale? Allora stiamo cercando te!

In Avanade lavoriamo per fornire ai nostri partner le migliori soluzioni possibili sfruttando al meglio le tecnologie più all'avanguardia. In quest'ottica, stiamo potenziando il nostro team di business analyst in ambito Dati e Artificial Intelligence (Data&AI), capaci di apportare consistente expertise nell'introduzione, implementazione ed evoluzione di processi, strumenti e metodologie.

Cosa Farai

Come Business Analyst con esperienza in progetti in ambito di Data Platform e Data Science, ti specializzerai nella scrittura di analisi dei processi, analisi funzionali e modellazione di processi di business. Supporterai lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di soluzioni avanzate in ambito di Dati e di intelligenza artificiale (generative e non), migliorando processi e prodotti, e assicurando che il risultato sia pertinente, accurato e coerente con i requisiti condivisi dal cliente. Colmerai il divario tra business e tecnologia traducendo le esigenze aziendali in requisiti tecnici.

Qualifications

Competenze ed esperienze:


Comprovata esperienza di almeno 3 anni nell’analisi di processi as-is e implementazione di soluzioni to-be di Data Platforming, AI o più in generale di Data Science.
Esperienza nella redazione, gestione ed esecuzione di analisi funzionali e di test list.
Capacità di modellare requisiti informativi (entità, attributi, relazioni). Saper definire metriche e indicatori in modo univoco.
Familiarità con modelli dimensionali (star schema, snowflake schema) e concetti di data mart.
Conoscenza dei servizi di gestione dei Dati e dei servizi di AI applicati alla generazione automatica di contenuti in diversi contesti (conoscenza di OpenAI e Microsoft Copilot sono un plus).
Conoscenze statistiche/analitiche e di linguaggi di programmazione come SQL e Python sono considerati un plus per validare i dati o supportare analisi.
Conoscere framework come Dama DMBok concetti di Data Management sono considerati un plus.
Eccellenti capacità di organizzazione del tempo, gestione dei progetti e collaborazione in team multidisciplinari.
Capacità di supportare risorse junior con buone capacità di comunicazione e mentoring.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese sia scritta che parlata.


Il tuo profilo


Analitic* e curios*.
Team player
Problem-solver paziente e orientat* alla qualità.
Propositiv* e proattiv*, Con un mindset innovativo.

In Avanade troverai un'azienda meritocratica che investe sulla crescita delle persone attraverso percorsi di studio mirati e che prevedono una continua formazione - grazie alle partnership privilegiate con Microsoft e con alcuni dei più importanti player del settore - e il conseguimento di numerose certificazioni. 

Il luogo ideale in cui lavorare: 

Il nostro ambiente di lavoro è aperto e inclusivo, potrai quindi esprimere le tue idee e lavorare a progetti innovativi attraverso l’ultima tecnologia disponibile sul mercato, confrontarti con migliaia di consulenti in Italia e nel mondo. Inoltre, potrai godere di programmi di flexible e smart-working e di benefit personalizzati in base alle tue esigenze professionali e individuali, che comprendono agevolazioni, servizi e piani di corporate Well-Being.
